description: Unit test class for FeedbackStorageCodec, testing encode/decode functionality, escaping, handling of empty/well-formed/malformed JSON, and partial object decoding.

classes.name: FeedbackStorageCodecTest
classes.description: JUnit test class testing FeedbackStorageCodec's encode and decode functions for various scenarios including proper serialization, escaping, and robustness against malformed JSON.

methods.name: encodeDecode_roundTrip_singleItem
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of a single FeedbackItem and verifies the data integrity after roundtrip.

methods.name: encodeDecode_roundTrip_multipleItems_latestFirst_preserveOrder
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of multiple FeedbackItems, ensuring the order is preserved and data matches.

methods.name: encode_escapesQuotesAndBackslashesAndControls
methods.description: Validates that encode method escapes quotes, backslashes, newlines, tabs, and carriage returns correctly, and that decoding yields original data.

methods.name: decode_emptyAndWhitespace_returnsEmptyList
methods.description: Ensures decode returns empty list for empty, whitespace, and empty array JSON inputs.

methods.name: decode_corrupted_returnsEmptyList_noCrash
methods.description: Confirms that decode returns an empty list and does not crash on malformed JSON inputs.

methods.name: decode_missingFields_skipsInvalidObjects
methods.description: Verifies that decode skips JSON objects missing required fields, processing only valid objects.
